comparison.objective: Secure glass plates into a gel-casting cassette and insert it into a spring-loaded stand.
comparison.physical_skill: Plate alignment, cam closure, lever holding, and offset insertion rather than impact fracture and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Aligned plates secured, cassette seated, lever released, grippers withdrawn, and assembly stable.
comparison.reason: This is compliant fixture assembly and latching, not removal of sacrificial tangs. No spec versions or explicit alignment/stability thresholds are supplied.
